faqs.q: What is a 2-inch Fig.1502 analogic pressure sensor with a debooster and 6-inch gauge used for?
faqs.a: It is a pressure sensing assembly for high-pressure wellhead lines: a 2-inch Fig.1502 debooster passes HP wellhead pressure to a 6-inch glycerine-filled gauge, and an adjustable overpressure shutdown proximity switch gives an interlock for ESD logic. See the [analogic pressure sensors shelf](/c/ic-analogic-pressure-sensors).

faqs.q: What does the debooster do in the Indus analogic pressure sensor?
faqs.a: The debooster provides safe transfer of high-pressure wellhead pressure to the analogic gauge circuit, so the gauge does not see the full line pressure directly. It is a 2-inch Fig.1502 connection.

faqs.q: What pressure ranges does the analogic pressure sensor cover?
faqs.a: Pressure ranges to 15,000 psi are available. State the working pressure of your line and we confirm the range and gauge scale. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: What gauge does the analogic pressure sensor use?
faqs.a: It uses a 6-inch glycerine-filled gauge for smooth pointer reading. The glycerine fill damps pulsation from pumps so the pointer is easier to read.

faqs.q: What material are the wetted parts of the analogic pressure sensor?
faqs.a: The wetted connections are SS316. NACE MR-0175 materials are available on request for sour service. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Can the analogic pressure sensor be supplied to NACE MR-0175?
faqs.a: Yes, the listing says NACE MR-0175 is available on request. Say so when you order, because it changes the materials. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: How does the adjustable shutdown on the analogic pressure sensor work?
faqs.a: An adjustable overpressure shutdown proximity switch enables interlock with ESD logic and shutdown sequencers. Set it to the trip pressure and wire it to the shutdown system.

faqs.q: How should I connect the analogic pressure sensor to a line?
faqs.a: Use the 2-inch Fig.1502 connection on the debooster, and check the pressure range against the line before pressurising. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation).

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the Fig.1502 analogic pressure sensor?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Analogic Pressure Sensor, 2-inch Fig.1502 Debooster, 6-inch Gauge + Adjustable Shutdown, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Analogic or electronic: which pressure sensor should I choose?
faqs.a: The analogic sensor shows pressure on a 6-inch glycerine gauge with a shutdown switch, while the [electronic pressure sensor](/p/electronic-pressure-sensor-0-15-000-psi-2-inch-fig-1502m-4-20-ma) gives a 4-20 mA output for data acquisition. Use the analogic one for local reading and the electronic one for remote logging.

faqs.q: Where is the analogic pressure sensor supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the pressure range and connection when you ask. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Is the Fig.1502 analogic pressure sensor in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we hold the Fig.1502 analogic pressure sensor in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
